name: How do I choose the right type of primer for my siding?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right type of primer for my siding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right primer depends on your siding material and the topcoat you plan to use. For wood siding, oil-based primers are excellent for blocking stains and providing a strong bond, while acrylic latex primers are suitable for good adhesion and flexibility. Fiber cement siding often benefits from a high-quality acrylic latex primer designed for masonry or cementitious surfaces. Metal siding requires rust-inhibiting primers. Always ensure the primer is compatible with your chosen finish paint for optimal performance and durability. Consult with a professional or paint supplier if unsure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select primer based on siding material (wood, fiber cement, metal) and topcoat compatibility. Oil-based works for wood, acrylic latex for fiber cement.
